001package com.streamConverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml.XmlNavigateCommand;
009import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
010import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
011import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
012import java.io.IOException;
013import java.io.InputStream;
014import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018/**
019 * Quick start examples for StreamConverter.
020 *
021 * <p>This provides simple, runnable examples of core functionality.
022 */
023public class QuickStart {
024  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(QuickStart.class);
025
026  /**
027   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。StreamConverterの基本的な使用例を実行します。
028   *
029   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
030   */
031  public static void main(String[] args) {
032    log.info("🚀 StreamConverter Quick Start Examples");
033    log.info("========================================\n");
034
035    try {
036      // Example 1: CSV column extraction
037      csvExample();
038
039      // Example 2: JSON property extraction
040      jsonExample();
041
042      // Example 3: XML element extraction
043      xmlExample();
044
045      // Example 4: Command pipeline
046      pipelineExample();
047
048      log.info("✅ All examples completed successfully!");
049
050    } catch (Exception e) {
051      log.error("❌ Example failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
052    }
053  }
054
055  /** Example 1: CSV column extraction */
056  private static void csvExample() throws IOException {
057    log.info("📊 CSV Example");
058    log.info("===============");
059
060    String csvData = "name,age,city\nJohn,30,NYC\nJane,25,LA\n";
061
062    // Extract name column
063    IStreamCommand csvCommand = CsvNavigateCommand.create("name", new PassThroughRule());
064    String result = processData(csvData, csvCommand);
065
066    log.info("Input CSV:");
067    log.info(csvData);
068    log.info("Extracted 'name' column:");
069    log.info(result);
070    log.info("");
071  }
072
073  /** Example 2: JSON property extraction */
074  private static void jsonExample() throws IOException {
075    log.info("🔍 JSON Example");
076    log.info("================");
077
078    String jsonData = "{\"name\":\"John\",\"age\":30,\"city\":\"NYC\"}";
079
080    // Extract name property
081    IStreamCommand jsonCommand = JsonNavigateCommand.create("name", new PassThroughRule());
082    String result = processData(jsonData, jsonCommand);
083
084    log.info("Input JSON:");
085    log.info(jsonData);
086    log.info("Extracted 'name' property:");
087    log.info(result);
088    log.info("");
089  }
090
091  /** Example 3: XML element extraction */
092  private static void xmlExample() throws IOException {
093    log.info("🌲 XML Example");
094    log.info("===============");
095
096    String xmlData =
097        """
098        <?xml version="1.0"?>
099        <person>
100          <name>John</name>
101          <age>30</age>
102          <city>NYC</city>
103        </person>
104        """;
105
106    // Extract name element
107    IStreamCommand xmlCommand = XmlNavigateCommand.create("person/name", new PassThroughRule());
108    String result = processData(xmlData, xmlCommand);
109
110    log.info("Input XML:");
111    log.info(xmlData);
112    log.info("Extracted 'name' element:");
113    log.info(result);
114    log.info("");
115  }
116
117  /** Example 4: Command pipeline */
118  private static void pipelineExample() throws IOException {
119    log.info("🔗 Pipeline Example");
120    log.info("====================");
121
122    String csvData = "id,name,status\n1,John,active\n2,Jane,inactive\n";
123
124    // Create processing pipeline
125    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
126      CsvNavigateCommand.create("name", new PassThroughRule()), // Extract names
127      new SampleStreamCommand("processor") // Process names
128    };
129
130    String result = processData(csvData, pipeline);
131
132    log.info("Input CSV:");
133    log.info(csvData);
134    log.info("Pipeline result (name extraction + processing):");
135    log.info(result);
136    log.info("");
137  }
138
139  /** Helper method to process data with a single command */
140  private static String processData(String inputData, IStreamCommand command) throws IOException {
141    return processData(inputData, new IStreamCommand[] {command});
142  }
143
144  /** Helper method to process data with command pipeline */
145  private static String processData(String inputData, IStreamCommand[] commands)
146      throws IOException {
147    try (InputStream inputStream =
148            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
149        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
150
151      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
152      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
153
154      return outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
155    }
156  }
157}
